feedback: Repair the bow-form alternatives: SHACL SPARQL SELECT results are violations, but the applicable branch currently selects valid angle evidence and the non-applicable branch selects invalid evidence, so sh:or can accidentally pass both cases. Make the applicable branch pass only when gamma > 0, gamma < 80, and beta' > 10, and make the non-applicable branch pass only when the angle evidence demonstrates the complementary condition; do not allow a missing branch-selection evidence set to pass. Also avoid imposing buttockAngle and normalFrameAngle minCount on every ship through both alternatives: keep those requirements conditional while ensuring the selected branch has the required angle evidence. Preserve the ship-to-hullAreaAssignment-to-assignedHullArea path and the two declared controlled alternatives, all operand paths, datatypes, and units.

The bow-form alternatives still impose buttockAngle and normalFrameAngle sh:minCount 1 in both branch node shapes, so sh:or makes both angle properties mandatory for every ship and contradicts the conditional applicability requirement. Remove those branch minCount constraints; retain the two SPARQL branch checks so a branch passes only when both angle operands are present and establish either the applicable condition (gamma > 0, gamma < 80, beta' > 10) or its complementary non-applicable condition. With neither or incomplete angle evidence, both branches must fail, preventing missing branch-selection evidence from passing. Preserve the existing canonical owners, paths, units, datatypes, controlled alternatives, and exact inclusive AR = 3.6 bounds.
